# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 34 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_034_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 5, Chapter 2 — Against Anger

**1** "Remove anger and bitterness from yourself, and you will be found in full possession of your senses with the Holy Spirit. **2** Be on guard against anger, for it is an evil and harmful spirit. See how anger destroys the minds of people with incomplete faith — indeed, it even destroys the minds of the most righteous. **3** For anger is thoroughly destructive, for it is the instrument of the devil. **4** Free yourself from anger by replacing it with long-suffering. For where there is bitterness, death is there, and the bitter person will not inherit the kingdom of God. **5** Those who are angry are thus mastered by the devil and cast away from the Lord, and they become corrupted. **6** But those who are patient resist the evil one — and in resisting him they gain power over him and overcome him. The patient person will live to God, and the long-suffering person will overcome the evil one." **7** "Sir, I would like to understand the operation of anger — how it destroys the minds of God's servants." **8** He replied, "Even the most gentle person, when anger overtakes him, becomes exceedingly bitter in short order — because of a wife, a child, a servant, a friend, a fellow believer, or some business transaction. He becomes arrogant and sharp in his speech. **9** After that, total bitterness sets in, and he remembers neither God nor Christ the Lord, and he speaks words of injustice and lawlessness, piling evil upon evil. **10** This is why the patience of God is necessary: patience drives anger away and utterly destroys it from the person's heart."

---

*LOGOS note: The escalation pattern in v. 8-10 — from trivial trigger to total spiritual forgetting — is one of the Shepherd's sharpest moral-psychological observations. The forgetting of "God nor Christ the Lord" in the anger spiral is an extraordinary statement.*
